## Summary

Describe the problem and the change in clear English.

## Validation

- [ ] `make lint`
- [ ] `make test`
- [ ] `make build`
- [ ] Additional checks are documented below

## Resource and safety impact

Describe changes to memory use, CPU use, container limits, or experiment safety.
Write `None` when the change has no relevant impact.

## Documentation

- [ ] Documentation is updated, or no documentation change is required
- [ ] New design decisions have an English ADR when appropriate
